title: The Journey Through Seir and Moab
description: Israel travels around Mount Seir and onward through the territories of Moab and the Ammonites. The Lord forbids them from attacking the descendants of Esau, Lot, and the Ammonites, because these lands have already been given as their possession. At the crossing of the Zered Brook, the end is marked for the old generation of fighting men after thirty-eight years of wandering from Kadesh-barnea.
